description: This file defines various sensor and trigger entities for the game, including their activation, reset, and behavior logic. It manages sensors for game stages, game end, buildables, players, support, power, and creep, with functions for initialization, activation, and periodic checks.

methods.name: InitBrushSensor
methods.description: Initializes a brush sensor entity, setting its model, contents, and linking it in the game world.

methods.name: sensor_act
methods.description: Toggles the enabled state of a sensor entity.

methods.name: sensor_reset
methods.description: Resets the sensor's enabled state based on spawn flags.

methods.name: trigger_compat_propagation_act
methods.description: Deprecated function to propagate use-events, issues a warning.

methods.name: sensor_checkWaitForReactivation_think
methods.description: Handles reactivation timing for sensors.

methods.name: trigger_checkWaitForReactivation
methods.description: Sets up reactivation delay or frees the entity.

methods.name: sensor_start_fireAndForget
methods.description: Fires the sensor entity once and then deletes it.

methods.description: Placeholder for sensor start entity spawn function.

methods.name: G_notify_sensor_start
methods.description: Notifies all sensor start entities to activate.

methods.description: Handles timer sensor firing and scheduling next activation.
